stacks.name: The Solo Freelancer Starter Stack
stacks.description: One AI assistant for thinking and drafting, one tool for making anything look designed, a writing check on client-facing emails, and a calendar that plans your day for you.

stacks.name: The Local Service Business Stack
stacks.business_type: Local service businesses (contractors, salons, repair shops)
stacks.description: A phone system that summarizes every customer call, bookkeeping that answers 'how's business this month?' in plain English, a chat widget for after-hours questions, and a website that took a minute to build.

stacks.name: The Small E-Commerce Stack
stacks.description: Product graphics and ads, on-brand marketing copy at volume, AI that qualifies and follows up with leads, and bookkeeping that keeps up with order volume.

stacks.name: The Creator / Coach Stack
stacks.description: Edit video by editing text, generate presenter video without filming, a workspace that writes and organizes with you, and every client call auto-summarized.

stacks.name: The Small Agency / Consultancy Stack
stacks.business_type: Small agencies, consultancies, real estate teams
stacks.description: A CRM that builds itself from your inbox, a calendar that re-plans around client deadlines, meeting notes you never have to type, and an AI assistant for the actual deliverable work.

stacks.name: The Customer-Support-Heavy Business Stack
stacks.description: Ticket resolution on autopilot, a chat widget catching questions before they become tickets, AI call summaries for phone support, and a CRM tying every customer touchpoint together.
